Indian IT Stocks Dip Amid US Rate Hike Fears

Indian IT stocks experienced a decline on Monday, with the Nifty IT index falling over 2%. Major companies including Infosys, HCLTech, and TCS saw their share prices drop by up to 3%. This downturn is attributed to stronger-than-expected US jobs data, which has revived concerns about a potential September interest rate hike by the US Federal Reserve. Despite the short-term dip, analysts suggest longer-term opportunities may arise from AI-led spending.
